$docx = "C:\Users\admin\AppData\Local\Temp\wps-windows-check\20261022T134558Z-3095499-eval\run-2\html-complex-report-to-docx\report.docx"
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem
$zip = [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead($docx)
$entry = $zip.Entries | Where-Object { $_.FullName -eq 'word/document.xml' }
$reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($entry.Open())
$xmlText = $reader.ReadToEnd(); $reader.Close(); $zip.Dispose()
[xml]$doc = $xmlText
$ns = New-Object System.Xml.XmlNamespaceManager($doc.NameTable)
$ns.AddNamespace('w','http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main')
$tbl = $doc.SelectSingleNode('//w:tbl', $ns)
"table_rows=" + $tbl.SelectNodes('./w:tr', $ns).Count
foreach ($tr in $tbl.SelectNodes('./w:tr', $ns)) {
  $cells = @()
  foreach ($tc in $tr.SelectNodes('./w:tc', $ns)) {
    $span = $tc.SelectSingleNode('./w:tcPr/w:gridSpan', $ns)
    $vm = $tc.SelectSingleNode('./w:tcPr/w:vMerge', $ns)
    $txt = ($tc.SelectNodes('.//w:t', $ns) | ForEach-Object { $_.InnerText }) -join ''
    $cells += ($txt + $(if ($span) { "[span=$($span.GetAttribute('val','http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main'))]" } else { '' }) + $(if ($vm) { "[vMerge=$($vm.GetAttribute('val','http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main'))]" } else { '' }))
  }
  "ROW: " + ($cells -join ' | ')
}
$drawings = $doc.SelectNodes('//w:drawing', $ns).Count
"drawings=$drawings"
